summary: Official Bangladesh DLRS services and the Sandwip Upazila land-office site were verified. The DLRS public APIs expose Sandwip mouza-map catalog records and previews, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response or CRS was obtained; no GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bangla discovery queries, actual result URLs, and all executed requests are recorded in city-7525-sandwip.json.
requestOutcomes: The official DLRS location/search/map-metadata routes returned catalog metadata. English search returned zero results while Bangla spelling সন্দীপ returned four catalog records, two for Chattogram/Sandwip. Location search and map metadata did not return parcel geometry.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved as latitude/longitude. No coordinate shift applied and no exact-point parcel query completed.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed
compositeKeyProvenance: Only catalog-level metadata was exposed. The returned id values identify map records and were not treated as parcel identities; no composite parcel key was constructed.
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry response obtained; zero samples retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed because no public parcel feature service was found; this is not evidence of parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Bangladesh DLRS mouza-map catalog, Smart Land Map, Survey of Bangladesh map services, and Sandwip Upazila land office.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local Sandwip map catalog metadata and official custodian evidence only; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable parcel identity, geometry, and citywide completeness unverified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point remains [22.4851629353438,91.4768580398091] in latitude/longitude order.
A catalog miss, map-extent limitation, or unavailable parcel endpoint is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No unsafe owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other restricted fields were requested or retained.
No login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit source integration or runtime use.
uncertainty: Current public DLRS catalog data supports the existence of digitized Sandwip mouza maps, but parcel-level anonymous access, native parcel ID semantics, CRS, completeness, currency, and legal status remain unverified.
